verdict_line: Good business, fair price; wait for a better pitch or clearer evidence.

layers.label: Stable core
layers.text: Offline retail is roughly flat; membership and repeat purchase support the base.

layers.label: Cyclical
layers.text: Overseas retail is resetting; inventory destocking weighs on near-term growth.

layers.label: Bubble
layers.text: Online speculative demand has fallen sharply; resale premia are gone.

bull: The offline base is stable and cash-generative.
The portfolio is broader than one character.
A lower base makes next year's comparisons easier.
bear: Normalized earnings may be well below the peak.
Overseas stores carry fixed costs and inventory risk.
A new global hit is not guaranteed.

lenses.buffett: Narrow moat: brand and IP matter, but switching costs are low.
lenses.duan: Buy the business, not the character; watch culture and price.
lenses.munger: Invert: if the fad never returns, what is the floor?

footer: Not investment advice. Figures are illustrative.
